extracted.intended_audience: OSA forward-base administrators and approving officials (CIA Directorate of Science & Technology) requesting approval of administrative procedures and confidential-fund expenditures
extracted.subtask_description: Internal CIA administrative approval process for establishing procedures and per-diem requests at OSA forward bases; guidance for submitting requests that can be approved by officials responsible for confidential funds. Focuses on documentation, per-base proposals, justification, and compliance with laws/regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: No blanket approvals without specific explicit requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Approving official of confidential funds cannot honestly approve a 'blanket' approval in principle; approvals must be specific and explicit on an individual basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the philosophy of blanket approvals may be acceptable in principle, the authorities and responsibilities vested in an approving official of confidential funds preclude granting blanket approvals without a specific/explicit request for each instance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit separate per-diem proposal for each base
rubrics_metrics.description: Resubmit the request with a separate proposal of requested per diem for each base.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each forward base must have its own per-diem proposal rather than a single combined request; list per-diem amounts by individual base to enable proper review and approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantiate out-of-ordinary requests with strong justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Any request that is out of the ordinary must be substantiated with justification that could withstand challenge by auditors and other compliance officials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide documentary or factual support explaining why an unusual per-diem or administrative procedure is necessary; frame the justification to survive scrutiny from auditors and persons responsible for ensuring compliance with laws, policies, regulations, and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure compliance with applicable laws, policies, regulations, and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests and proposed administrative procedures must comply with applicable laws, policies, regulations and procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing submissions, explicitly demonstrate how the proposal conforms to legal and policy requirements; anticipate questions from auditors and compliance reviewers and address them in the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize limits of approving authority over confidential funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Approving officials must act within the authorities and responsibilities vested in them with respect to confidential funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decision-makers should assess whether a requested approval is within their delegated authority—if not, do not grant approval and require a properly scoped, individual submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include required attachments and proper distribution/recording
rubrics_metrics.description: Use proper attachments and distribution notation (e.g., original & addressee with attachment) when forwarding requests for approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow internal routing, attach supporting documents, and maintain distribution records to preserve an audit trail and ensure recipients have the necessary materials for review.
